title: Counting vowels in a string
description: You can follow character membership tests into a running count.

steps.description: You initialize vowels to zero and visit each character of micro:bit. letter holds one character on each pass.
The membership test checks whether letter appears in aeiou. A matching character increases vowels by one.

steps.question: Will the colon contribute to the count?
steps.answer: No. The colon is absent from aeiou, so the increment is skipped for that character.

steps.description: The two i characters and the o contribute three matches. You see Found 3 vowels after the loop.
